instances.claim: This tells me that Rutherford Chang chose the penny because it is the most reproduced artwork on Earth.
instances.why: Line 2 holds the decision expression ('chose', attributed to Rutherford Chang) and line 1, immediately before it, states a property of the object (most reproduced artwork on Earth) that reads as the reason for the choice; the draft states no reason, motive or origin for Chang's selection anywhere — lines 3–24 describe the work's humor, its five transformations of value, and an argument about commodification and objecthood, none of it offered as his motive — so the sequence supplies the only motive present. Neither line alone claims anything about why he chose it: line 1 is a fact about the coin, line 2 a fact about his choice.
